# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:1e873bcc571b7b7717ee66b62aff1ec3e361ead12088e6b707b77e88ee008328

Private LLM inference documentation. Public weights; provider follows the protocol.

- [CLI reference](https://pllm.run/cli/reference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/reference.md)): Exact commands, arguments, and help text from the installed PLLM CLI.
- [Command-line interface](https://pllm.run/cli/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli.md)): Inspect PLLM configuration, components, and research records from the terminal.
